description: DiligenceOps: submit a fee schedule and a quote or invoice, as text or as lines. The signed report pairs each charge with its schedule fee by label, lists the charges the schedule does not list and the listed fees charged at a different amount, rate or currency, with the expected amount and the difference to the cent. POST /api/fee-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-terms-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

base_amount.description: Optional amount that percentage fees apply to. Defaults to the subtotal the charges state.

anyOf.description: The quote or invoice as text, one line item per line.

amount.description: A non-negative amount as a decimal string or number, up to 6 places, for example "49.99".

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

label.description: The line as the quote or invoice names it.

charges.description: The quote or invoice as text, or up to 500 lines as {label, amount, currency, quantity}.

charges_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

currency.description: Currency for amounts that omit one.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

anyOf.description: The fee schedule as text, one fee per line.

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

label.description: The fee as the schedule names it, for example "Setup fee".

percent.description: A rate in percent, for example 2.9.

schedule.description: The published fee schedule as text, or up to 200 fees as {label, amount or percent, currency}.

schedule_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

name: wever_fee-evidence-check
title: Fee evidence check
